question: Duare Ration Scheme, which has been deemed legally void by the high court, was launched by which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Duare Ration Scheme** was launched by the state government of **West Bengal** in 2021.
 
• The initiative aimed to deliver food grains and other ration materials directly to the doorstep of beneficiaries under the Public Distribution System (PDS).
 
• It was part of the state government’s efforts to improve the accessibility of essential goods for economically weaker sections.
 
• The scheme was declared legally void by the Calcutta High Court in 2022, citing that it overlapped with the central government’s National Food Security Act (NFSA).
 
• The ruling highlighted that states do not have the authority to modify or create parallel schemes that conflict with central legislation like the NFSA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013:**

 
 
• The NFSA provides subsidized food grains to approximately two-thirds of India’s population.
 
• It is a central government initiative aimed at ensuring food security for economically weaker sections.
 
• The Act covers priority households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) beneficiaries.
 
• Under the Act, eligible households receive 5 kg of food grains per person per month at highly subsidized rates.
 
 
 
• **Public Distribution System (PDS):**
 
 
• PDS is a government-managed system that distributes essential commodities like rice, wheat, and sugar to eligible beneficiaries.
 
• It aims to ensure food security and mitigate hunger, especially for low-income families.
 
• PDS operates through a network of Fair Price Shops (FPS) across the country.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal's Welfare Initiatives:**
 
 
• West Bengal has implemented several welfare schemes, including 'Khadya Sathi,' which provides subsidized food grains to 90% of the state’s population.
 
• The state government has also focused on doorstep delivery schemes like 'Duare Sarkar' to improve service accessibility.
 
 
 
• **Legal Conflict in Duare Ration Scheme:**
 
 
• The High Court ruled that the scheme conflicted with the central NFSA and lacked legal authority under the federal structure.
 
• The ruling emphasized that food distribution policies fall under the central government’s purview in India.
